name: Ovoid Jar with Decoration of Two Dragons, Each Striding amid Clouds over Mountains and Rolling Waves
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；Jiajing period, 1522-1566；Enameled porcelain: porcelain with an all-over coating of overglaze yellow enamel, the design reserved in red enamel against the yellow ground, the details articulated in black enamel on the reserved designs; with underglaze cobalt-blue mark reading "Da Ming Jiajing nian zhi" on the base.
